topics.title: Stern Confronts Kinison and Bon Jovi
topics.summary: Howard Stern recounts a disastrous meeting with John Bon Jovi and Sam Kinison where both men made threatening statements. After an awkward attempt to reconcile, Bon Jovi accused Stern of deliberately breaking Kinison’s chair while Kinison threatened Stern directly, ultimately ending the unproductive encounter.

topics.title: Stern Attacks Bon Jovi, Disputes Listener’s Claims
topics.summary: Howard Stern repeatedly trashed Bon Jovi during the broadcast, claiming they were awful and that he was working with comedy writers. He clashed with a caller who accused him of fabricating stories about his deceased brother, leading to an argument over perceived disrespect and personal attacks against Sam Kennison.
